'Logged with' and the MettleUp mark small at the foot

user_sees: The PNG with the logo drawn in it

must_not: An empty gap for a logo

user_sees: 'Your gym's logo did not load' with 'The picture now shows your gym's name only. Tap Share picture again.'
The preview now shows the name only
must_not: A PNG saved without the logo and no word
The same failure on every tap

'The picture never shows your name, your gym or your body weight.'

A 'Your gym' choice with nothing behind it

'The picture never shows your name, your gym or your body weight.'
must_not: The gym still on the saved PNG

must_not: The logo missing after it was shown before
